diagnosis: The support ticket viewing endpoint returns SupportTicketOverview with @computed_field properties customer_tier_label and internal_churn_propensity. It fails to check if ticket.author_id == caller.id or if caller is an internal retention manager, leaking the customer's financial VIP designation and internal predictive churn score to any customer or third-party agent.
exploit_request:
GET /support/tickets/tkt_992140/view HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.saasservice.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
